data.name: Blind Crest Rally
data.detailed_description:
Blind Crest Rally is a physics-driven rally game with procedurally generated stages and handling tuned to be realistic and fun. Chase stage times across rally eras in Campaign, Time Trial, and a competitive Daily Stage with global leaderboards.

Realistic rally handling

Physics based handling with convincing grip, weight transfer and suspension. Tuned to feel great with both controller and keyboard, with optional assists for those who want it.

Procedurally generated stages

Every stage is generated from a seed, creating fresh routes and terrain every run. Trust in your copilot because you can’t rely on memorizing the road.

Cars across rally eras

Drive everything from compact classics to group B monsters and modern machines. The game features cars from different rally eras, each with unique handling and performance characteristics.

Physics-synthesized engine audio

Engine sound is generated in realtime and unique for each car’s engine parameters. It responds to changes in RPM, gears, tuning and damage

Campaign

Progress through the different rally eras with multi-stage events. Manage damage, choose when to push and beat your opponents.

Daily stage + leaderboards

A new daily seed gives everyone the same stage conditions. Set your time, replay and improve, and compete against the leaderboard.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 (4 GB) / AMD RX 560 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS 64-bit (or equivalent)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 (4 GB) / AMD RX 560 (4 GB)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan-capable GPU
